# Gravel Bike Rebuild

Rebuilding the old steel frame as a gravel bike.

- Swap to a 1x drivetrain with an 11-42 cassette and a 40t chainring.
- Replace the bent derailleur hanger before indexing the gears.
- Convert both wheels to tubeless; notes in [[Tubeless Tyres]].
- Fit 45 mm tyres and check clearance at the chainstay.
